description.value:
Traits Signal

Nothing ends your Broadcast except your own choice or your death. Counteracts fail, silence and deafness do not stop it, antimagic does not suppress it, no condition ends it, and falling unconscious does not end it whether or not you have Never Off. Only you can Dismiss it, and you must be able to act to do so.

cinderfall.incomplete: Same blocker as Never Off / Nobody Decoded It, escalated; SB3. No "Broadcast" stance/aura item is ever instantiated as an Item with its own system.rules anywhere in this corpus. The shape (a stance whose aura buffs allies) is real and buildable in pf2e via Aura + a companion effect item -- but no such Broadcast item exists among this class's files to attach a rule element to.
